title: Law Dome Ice Core 2000-Year CO2, CH4, N2O and d13C-CO2
citation: Rubino, Mauro et al. (2019), v3, CSIRO. DOI: 10.25919/5bfe29ff807fb

columns.ice_year_ce: Calendar year of ice, not years before present
columns.co2_ppm: Published corrected CO2 dry-air mole fraction, WMO X2007
columns.uncertainty_ppm: Published concentration uncertainty, see Rubino et al. 2019 supplement S1.3

processing: Select two samples from one core. Copy calendar years to 2 decimals and concentration and uncertainty to 3 decimals. Calculate gas_year_ce minus ice_year_ce and the later-minus-earlier concentration difference. No interpolation, fitting, recalibration or additional correction.
scope: Processed published data. The example does not reproduce raw chromatograms, the extraction correction or the firn model. Neither the delta-age nor its uncertainty is independently inferred here.
